Hi,

Does anybody know of any example code for the use of the dNmixture_s or dNmixture_v or variates that exist in the nimbleEcology package.  I'm specifically looking for dNmixture_BBNB_v but would settle for anything in the general family.

Thanks!
Brian

messages.author: 9b1f1220a2b07d1e
messages.subject: Fwd: nimbleEcology dNmixture_v or variates example code
parts:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Ben Goldstein <ben.go...@berkeley.edu>
Date: Mon, Oct 31, 2022 at 8:48 AM
Subject: Re: nimbleEcology dNmixture_v or variates example code
To: Brian B <drveg...@gmail.com>


Hi Brian,

Here is an example of some model code using the BBNB distribution: https://github.com/dochvam/GLMM_Nmix_reproducible/blob/main/model_code.R

This is the github repository associated with this manuscript: doi.org/10.1038/s41598-022-16368-z

Note that these models were used for MLE, not Bayesian MCMC, so there aren't any priors.

The different N-mixture variants should all function the same, with the addition or exclusion of the 2 overdispersion parameters.

Ben
